```{python}
#| label: setup
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join('..', '..'))
import report_data as rd
import pandas as pd

RUN_SET_ID = "speed-factors"
SHP_PATH = os.path.join('..', '..', '..', 'run_sets', RUN_SET_ID, 'inputs', 'sfac-screenlines.shp')
SCENARIO_COLORS = {"sfac-base": "#1f77b4", "sfac-removed": "#e6550d"}
```

```{python}
#| label: load-data
runs = rd.latest_run_per_scenario(RUN_SET_ID)
run_by_scenario = {r["scenario_id"]: r for r in runs}

def screenline_csv_path(run):
    if not run or run.get("status") != "success":
        return None
    for p in rd.curated_output_paths(run):
        if "Summary_Screenline" in p:
            return rd.REPO_ROOT / p
    return None

frames = {}
for scenario_id in ("sfac-base", "sfac-removed"):
    run = run_by_scenario.get(scenario_id)
    path = screenline_csv_path(run)
    if path and path.is_file():
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        df["ScreenlineID"] = df["ScreenlineID"].astype(float).round(3)
        frames[scenario_id] = df

have_both = "sfac-base" in frames and "sfac-removed" in frames
```

```{python}
#| label: waiting-message

if not have_both:
    missing = [s for s in ("sfac-base", "sfac-removed") if s not in frames]

    ))
```

```{python}
#| label: build-comparison
#| output: asis
if have_both:
    import geopandas as gpd
    import plotly.express as px

    gdf = gpd.read_file(SHP_PATH)
    labels = gdf[gdf["Type"] != "Original"][["ID2", "Type", "Label"]].rename(columns={"ID2": "ScreenlineID"})
    labels["ScreenlineID"] = labels["ScreenlineID"].astype(float).round(3)

    base = frames["sfac-base"][["ScreenlineID", "DY_Vol"]].rename(columns={"DY_Vol": "sfac-base"})
    removed = frames["sfac-removed"][["ScreenlineID", "DY_Vol"]].rename(columns={"DY_Vol": "sfac-removed"})
    merged = labels.merge(base, on="ScreenlineID", how="left").merge(removed, on="ScreenlineID", how="left")
    merged["change"] = merged["sfac-removed"] - merged["sfac-base"]
    merged["pct_change"] = (merged["change"] / merged["sfac-base"] * 100).round(1)

    display(Markdown(
        "## Daily volume by screenline\n\n"
        "Daily (`DY_Vol`) volume at each screenline, base run vs. the "
        "speed-factors-removed run. **Facility** screenlines sit on the "
        "corridors that actually carry a speed factor; **Parallel** "
        "screenlines sit on the nearby route expected to absorb any diverted "
        "traffic."
    ))

    for screenline_type in ("Facility", "Parallel"):
        sub = merged[merged["Type"] == screenline_type].sort_values("Label")
        if sub.empty:
            continue
        long = sub.melt(
            id_vars=["Label"], value_vars=["sfac-base", "sfac-removed"],
            var_name="Scenario", value_name="DY_Vol",
        )
        fig = px.bar(
            long, x="DY_Vol", y="Label", color="Scenario", barmode="group",
            orientation="h", color_discrete_map=SCENARIO_COLORS,
            title=f"{screenline_type} screenlines — daily volume",
            height=max(500, 26 * sub["Label"].nunique()),
        )
        fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.0, xanchor="left", x=0),
                           margin=dict(t=70), yaxis_title="", xaxis_title="Daily volume")
        fig.show(config={"displayModeBar": False})

    display(Markdown("## Change table"))
    show_cols = ["Type", "Label", "sfac-base", "sfac-removed", "change", "pct_change"]
    display(merged[show_cols].sort_values(["Type", "pct_change"], ascending=[True, False]).style.hide(axis="index"))
```
